subject: Build fresh release binary & confirm version
learnings: Change-mgmt rule in practice: the installed rtk lagged; only target/release from the branch tells the truth.

subject: Re-verify documented grep/rg bug matrix on fresh build
learnings: Fresh build matched the report annotations: grep BRE still breaks; -c count + redirect already resolved.

subject: Proactively probe genuine rg-only usage for silent corruption
learnings: GOTCHA: my own Bash rg/grep calls are rewritten by the live Claude hook, so 'real rg' probes were actually rtk grep — must use RTK_DISABLED=1 for ground truth. Found alpha (rg '\|' over-match, silent) and beta (rg -r/-E stripped).

subject: Design source-tool-identity routing fix
learnings: ripgrep is deliberately NOT grep-compatible (BurntSushi FAQ) — so it's an alternative, not a replacement. Design: two native handlers (grep BRE-compat + rg verbatim/mode-aware) over a shared compaction core; rg is first-class, not a fallback.

subject: Check upstream rtk-ai/rtk for grep/rg dialect handling
learnings: Upstream has the IDENTICAL dialect-blind rule (rules.rs:92-94) and NO differential test harness — both the fix and the scoreboard are genuine backport candidates.

subject: Build differential scoreboard harness
learnings: Real tool as oracle = no hand-written expectations, can't drift. Routes via `rtk rewrite` so the board auto-tracks the grep/rg split as it lands.

subject: Add gate test + shareable report table + upstream column
learnings: Known-bug gating keeps cargo test green while the board stays honest: tagged cases asserted broken, so a fix trips the gate ('appears FIXED, lock it in'). Upstream-build automation (scripts/scoreboard.sh) deferred into the backport task #10.
